answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an agent earns full rewards only after trading with twelve distinct counterparties per epoch. A beacon publishes diversity scores, and like a meadow where herds graze apart, a healthy market spreads wide. Clones trading only with each other score near zero. Each identity posts a 50 POA deposit, so 100 fakes lock 5,000 POA for nothing. One honest agent pays one deposit, earns an ivory seal, and keeps full yield.
